body: I don't know why I got temp ban, it said I had combat log and the mod was GalaxyPop.

title: I dont know why I got temp ban.

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Combat logging is when you leave the server or leave your team in anticipation of dying.
This is not permitted on this server. Therefore you were temp-banned for 3 days.

Reagrds,
Kaliks12, Senior Moderator
